variants.headline: Start with the household's need
variants.body: Food is short in {colony}, and people are hungry. Working households need enough to eat; a debate cannot fill that need. Workers deserve practical answers.

variants.headline: The labour question on every plate
variants.body: Residents are hungry because food is insufficient in {colony}. Solidarity starts with treating enough to eat as a common need. Workers deserve practical answers.

variants.headline: Enough food is the common standard
variants.body: There is too little food in {colony}, and people are hungry. Enough to eat is a basic condition of a decent life. Workers deserve practical answers.
